claims.sourceText: Brief for the United States in opposition, Ronald W. Pelton v. United States, No. 87-6433, Office of the Solicitor General, https://www.justice.gov/osg/media/218076/dl
claims.text: Pelton was convicted of conspiracy to commit espionage, espionage and attempted espionage, and unauthorized disclosure of classified information, in the United States District Court for the District of Maryland.

claims.nodeLabel: United States v. Ronald W. Pelton (D. Md. 1986)
claims.sourceText: Brief for the United States in opposition, No. 87-6433, https://www.justice.gov/osg/media/218076/dl
claims.text: The government's brief describes the sentence as concurrent life terms on the espionage and conspiracy counts and a concurrent ten-year term on the unauthorized-disclosure count.

claims.nodeLabel: United States v. Ronald W. Pelton (D. Md. 1986)
claims.sourceText: Brief for the United States in opposition, No. 87-6433, https://www.justice.gov/osg/media/218076/dl
claims.text: On what was compromised the brief says only that Pelton furnished the Soviets information about several classified NSA operations; it does not name any operation, codename, cable, sea area or submarine.
